notes: The tutorial floor's lines (M7-P2), played once by a brand-new profile. One line per step; 'success' shows when the step is done. On the brute step the game uses the guided Counter lines from first-session-lessons.json, not this step's screen line (Manager call, M7-P2), so the brute step is kept here only for its retry/nudge text and the order. The Insight step is automatic with no menu; the real Insight choice is taught in session 3 (lesson-insights). Health never drops below 1 on this floor. C12 (Jay playtest: too fast; teach combat ideas), driven by the game since K24a: a space step and four combat tips, each followed by a try before the next. Keys per step: advance ('tap' = tap-to-continue, 'move' = wait for the player's move) and waitFor (the event the game waits for; null on tap steps). Every line is under 12 words; drafts/content/tools/check-tutorial.py checks it. No timers: every tip waits for a Got it tap.
speaker: sensei

lessons.trigger: Tutorial floor starts: bow at the door
screens: Bow at the door to show respect.
Tap where you want to go, or use the stick.

lessons.trigger: Open room; a few practice bags placed near the walls
screens: This room is big. Use all of it.

lessons.trigger: Slow brute appears and winds up (game slows, COUNTER pulses)
lessons.retry: Almost! The circle will come again.
lessons.nudge: Take your time. Tap the glowing COUNTER button!

lessons.trigger: Right after the brute step, before the next wave
screens: The red circle warns you first. Then COUNTER.
lessons.retry: Almost! The circle will come again.

lessons.trigger: Three Swarmers and one slow Brute enter together
screens: Little Swarmers first. Then it gets calmer.
lessons.retry: That's okay. The Swarmers will come back.

screens: Now the Brute. You can focus on it.

lessons.trigger: A small group of Swarmers enters
screens: Keep some space. Step back if it gets busy.

lessons.trigger: Swarmers close in from two sides (game slows, DASH pulses)
screens: Crowded? DASH out to open space.
lessons.nudge: Take your time. Tap the glowing DASH button!

lessons.trigger: After the fights: Sensei auto-picks one Insight (no menu, no cards)
screens: Here is an Insight for you!
lessons.success: It will help you until you go home.

screens: A treasure chest! Walk up to open it.
A big one! Watch the circles, like before.
